bio.text: Eric Jenkins, a Republican, is a candidate for Kansas's 3rd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging Democratic Rep. Sharice Davids.
He served on the Shawnee City Council from 2015 to 2023 and ran unsuccessfully for the Kansas House in 2016 and 2018.

According to his campaign website, as reported by KCUR, he spent 34 years on active and reserve duty in the U.S. Army, including deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan; KCUR reports he spent most of his professional career at the Federal Emergency Management Agency.
